title: A clear question bears an awkward answer
meaning: A methodical examination can direct your shared inquiry towards what matters while preserving the quiet courage to meet an uncomfortable answer.
text: Understanding something together becomes easier when you know which answer you are seeking. The Emperor in the physical position of Ajna suggests organising a sequence of checks: distinguishing conditions, examining examples and connecting observations. The Chariot in energy supports a wish to direct inquiry towards what matters and hold the discussion’s subject in view. Strength in emotions responds with quiet courage to meet an awkward correction.

For example, you prepare questions for a friendly quiz and check whether their answers are equally clear. One item allows two interpretations. **A strong shared view can bear an answer you did not expect.** Stepwise examination reveals where ambiguity lies in the question itself. Attention now goes towards wording beyond proving someone was inattentive. You can acknowledge an inaccuracy without abandoning all the work. The inquiry retains a clear purpose: understanding precisely what needs clarification while preserving interest in the material you prepared.

The difficulty comes if composure is taken for agreement with the first correction. Discussion moves on while a doubt remains unspoken. Your wish to keep the subject clear can help that doubt be heard specifically. A brief return to the wording preserves the value of earlier examination. Composure lets you test a correction fully even if one question needs a little more time.
